from pathlib import Path
progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)}
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for start in cells:
        if start in seen:
            continue
        color = cells[start]
        stack = [start]
        seen.add(start)
        obj = set()
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            obj.add((r, c))
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in cells and p not in seen and cells[p] == color:
                    seen.add(p)
                    stack.append(p)
        objects.append((color, obj))

    # The 2s mark the edge toward which every object slides.
    barrier = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    dr = 1 if barrier and min(r for r,c in barrier) == 0 else -1 if barrier and max(r for r,c in barrier) == h-1 else 0
    dc = 1 if barrier and min(c for r,c in barrier) == 0 else -1 if barrier and max(c for r,c in barrier) == w-1 else 0
    blocked = set(barrier)
    for _, obj in objects:
        blocked.update(obj)
    # Repeatedly advance objects toward the marked edge, nearest objects first.
    while True:
        moved = False
        order = sorted(range(len(objects)), key=lambda i: (min(r for r,c in objects[i][1])*dr if dr else min(c for r,c in objects[i][1])*dc), reverse=(dr < 0 or dc < 0))
        for i in order:
            color, obj = objects[i]
            nxt = {(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in obj}
            if any(r < 0 or r >= h or c < 0 or c >= w for r,c in nxt):
                continue
            other = blocked - obj
            if nxt & other:
                continue
            blocked.difference_update(obj)
            obj.clear(); obj.update(nxt)
            blocked.update(obj)
            moved = True
        if not moved:
            break
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in barrier:
        out[r][c] = 2
    for color,obj in objects:
        for r,c in obj:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
